title: Sagalee Gadaa irraa
intro: Oduu durii obsaa fi rahmata Rabbii daangaa hin qabne Qur’aana keessatti mul’ata. Ergamaan tokko gara magaalaa guddittii ergame, garuu sabni isaanii akeekkachiisa kana didee dhugaa dide. Mufachuudhaan lubbuun kun deemte — galaana dheekkamsaan qoramtee gadi fageenya dukkanaa’aa ta’etti liqimfamuu qofa. Garaa dukkanaa keessaa kadhannaan gad of qabuu ka’ee, Rahmaan deebii kenne. Lubbuun jijjiiramtee as baate, kan ummanni ishee amantoota kuma dhibbaa ol ta’an kun eenyu?
clues: Magaalaa guddittii jiraattonni ishee daandii amantii irraa maqan tokkotti akeekkachiisaa ta’ee ergame.
Ummata koo irra deddeebi’ee gara dhugaatti waamee, isaan garuu itti qoosanii ergaa koo didan.
Hayyamni osoo hin kennamin mufachuudhaan isaan irraa ka'ee, gara galaana banaatti qajeele.
Obomboleettiin guddaan tokko ka’ee, galaana keessa darbatame — achiis uumama galaanaa guddaa tokkoon guutummaatti liqimfame.

Marsaa dukkanaa keessatti — gadi fageenya galaanaa, garaa uumama, fi lafa galaanaa gadi fagoo — akkas jedheen iyye: ‘Ati malee waaqni biraa hin jiru; ulfinni Siif haa ta’u; Namoota balleessaa raawwatan keessaa tokkon ture’ jedheera.
Rabbiin gadi fageenya irraa na oolche, yeroon deebi’u ummanni koo kuma dhibbaa ol ta’u haqa hammatee ture.

outcome.answer: Dukkana keessaa bilisa; tuuti guddaan ni amanan

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
